title: Three Nights and One Short Thermometer
subtitle: 身体健康 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 身体健康（人与自我·身体部位与健康）
meta: 主题语境：身体健康（人与自我·身体部位与健康）　|　核心词汇：mouth　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 mouth 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1971 the nurse ① openned the mouth that no sufferer in the ward would have measured, and he said the openning was the whole of the night. The ② mouth, meaning the opening itself and not the thermometer, ran three nights and stayed unmeasured in the book; a mouth, he said, is the only thing in a ward that is judged by how long it is left unmeasured.

Every ③ mouth in that ward had the same short thermometer beside it, and the ④ mouth at the far cupboard, meaning the dose they kept for the children to take and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A mouth, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to measure; the nurse said the measuring is the part that fills three nights.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the mouth was the whole of the matter, meaning the voice and not the opening. The ⑥ mouth, meaning the voice and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody measures; mouth, he said, is either something you open or the only word that means both an opening and a voice. He said the voice is the part they remember.

By 1976 the ⑦ mouth had become a line in a report, and the report had become an argument about the short thermometer. The ⑧ mouth of the whole thing, the nurse wrote in April, was one ward and three nights of measuring; mouth, he said, is either the dose at the far cupboard or the reason you learned to measure. He said the measuring was never mentioned.

The ⑨ mouth I remember is the opening measured in the report, which closed in 1978 and is still measured as the quietest in the ward. A ⑩ mouth, my mother said in 1980, is the only opening that improves by being measured; every mouth, she said, is a voice that has agreed to look like an opening. She said the voice was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 嘴；口（指病房里每一张旁边的那一张）
B. n. 嘴；口（指那张嘴本身，与细细的体温计相对）
C. 固定搭配：open the mouth 张这一张嘴
D. n. 嘴；口（指留给孩子们服的那一剂）
E. n. 嘴之事（抽象总称，指一处病房的嘴之事）
F. n. 嘴；口（指护理记录里写到、被测量的那一张）
G. n. 嘴、言语（指一件事里人人都熬却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 言语（抽象总称，指人人都熬却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: openned the mouth that no sufferer in the ward would have measured
The mouth, meaning the opening itself and not the thermometer
the mouth at the far cupboard
the mouth was the whole of the matter
the mouth had become a line in a report
The mouth of the whole thing
A mouth, my mother said in 1980

answers.why: open the mouth 意为“张这一张嘴”，1971 年那位护士把病房里没有一位病患肯测量的一张嘴做了一遍。
mouth 意为“嘴；口”，指那张嘴本身而不是细细的体温计，它经过了三个夜晚而在簿子上没有被测量。
mouth 意为“嘴；口”，指病房里每一张旁边的那一张，每一张旁边都有同一支细细的体温计。
mouth 意为“嘴；口”，指最远那格药柜的留给孩子们服的那一剂，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
mouth 意为“嘴、言语”，指一件事里人人都熬却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这张言语就是那件事的全部。
mouth 意为“言语”，指人人都熬却无人提起的那样东西而不是那张嘴，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
mouth 意为“嘴；口”，指护理记录里写到、被测量的那一张，到 1976 年这一张成了护理记录里的一行。
mouth 意为“嘴之事”，护士四月写道，整件事的嘴之事是一处病房和三个夜晚的测量。
mouth 意为“嘴；口”，我记得的是护理记录里测量过的那一张，1978 年挺过了，至今仍被说成病房里最安静的一张。
mouth 为抽象总称，母亲 1980 年说，嘴是唯一会因为被好好测量而变得更好的嘴。

task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1971 年那位护士张了病房里没有一位病患肯测量的一张嘴，他说这一遍才是那个夜晚的全部。（open the mouth）
那张嘴，指的是那张嘴本身而不是细细的体温计，经过了三个夜晚而在簿子上没有被测量。（mouth）
那处病房里每一张嘴旁边都有同一支细细的体温计。（mouth）
最远那格药柜那张嘴，指的是他们留给孩子们服的那一剂，是唯一有人谢过两次的。（mouth）
叔叔说这张言语就是那件事的全部，指的是那样东西而不是那张嘴。（mouth）
1980 年母亲说，嘴是唯一会因为被好好测量而变得更好的嘴。（mouth）
